Item Class: Misc Map Items
Rarity: Currency
Inscribed Ultimatum
--------
Challenge: Protect the Altar
Area Level: 83
Requires Sacrifice: Divine Orb x1
Reward: Doubles sacrificed Currency
--------
Stalking Ruin
(An invulnerable shade stalks you, inflicting Ruin with its Melee Attacks
Fail on reaching 7 Ruin)
Razor Dance III
(Swarms of blades will periodically appear and fly at you, applying Corrupted Blood on Hit)
Reduced Recovery
(60% Reduced Life, Mana, and Energy Shield Recovery Rate)
Escalating Damage Taken
(For the remainder of the encounter, damage taken will slowly increase by 2% per second, up to 50%)
Lightning Damage from Mana Costs
(Take 1000% of Mana costs as Lightning Damage)
Deadly Monsters
(Monster Hits are always Critical Strikes)
Prismatic Monsters
(Monsters gain 50% of Physical Damage as Extra Damage of each Element)
10% increased Monster Damage
30% more Monster Life
--------
Can be used in a personal map device to open portals to the Trialmaster's Domain and attempt his challenge. Portals will close once the challenge begins. While viewing your Atlas, Right-click this item to pinpoint its location.
